args.purpose: Find the 5 customer states with the lowest average review score
args.sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_state,
    round(avg(r.review_score), 4) as avg_review_score,
    count(r.review_score) as review_count
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_review_score ASC, review_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
